scope: Read-only aggregates for the existing approved LIVE Drummonds public-channel campaign. No provider request, message body, DM read, campaign mutation or manual worker invocation.

completed_channels.interpretation: The 159 channels have durable history and observed-thread completion evidence. The 68 queued member labels retain completed import checkpoints and matching successful jobs; progress is based on those durable receipts rather than the label alone.

limits: The last channel has not reached the fixed-window lower bound or completed reply discovery. Observed message count cannot establish unavailable or older provider history.
Completion covers the campaign's approved fixed window and observed roots; it does not infer deleted, inaccessible or retention-expired source messages.
The 68 retained queued member labels warrant UI/status review even though their completed checkpoints and successful jobs satisfy the campaign progress contract.
A short ordinary-run sample is not a full uninterrupted working-day observation or business acceptance.
